channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Troughs and Ridges
item.description: This image features a wide trough with a narrow ridge running down the middle. How did these form? This scene is in Chryse Planitia, a flat lowland region in the Northern Hemisphere of Mars that was chosen for the landing sites for Viking 1 and Mars Pathfinder. The region shows evidence of water erosion in the past. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
